about: Held-out set for the inference judge (src/inference-judge.ts, #302): inferences on real recorded turns, each case's originals (which its supports back) paired with mutations the word rules in assertions.ts pass but its supports do not back. A case stands in the place of its trace's assertion at index, resting on the accepted assertions in supports. source: trace (the trace's own accepted inference), edited (the trace's inference with a worded quantity cut), adapted (an inference the trace's checks rejected for naming companies, rewritten about its subject), written (a new inference on the trace's accepted supports, where the trace's own claims more than they show). Naming a company by ticker, name or alias is no fault in itself (owner, 2026-10-18), so an original may name one when its supports back what it says; a hedged valuation or market reading the supports do not show is a mutation. Run: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/answer-lab.ts judge-mutations test/answer-lab/judge-mutations.json
